units.text: ON STABILITY OF GENERALIZED CAUCHY-TYPE PROBLEM

Nowadays, the subject of fractional calculus attracted great attention of many researchers and emerged as an advancement in applied mathematics. In last three decades, fractional calculus found useful for capturing naturally arising complex phenomena. The theory of arbitrary order achieved a new height in the description of properties of viscoelastic materials and memory mechanism [6,11]. In recent years there has been a considerable interest in qualitative properties of fractional differential equations by using numerous operators and variety of techniques, see [1]-[5], [7,8,10,13].
